title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
☀️ Good morning, Matthew! Today is Friday, November 13, 2026 (yes, Friday the 13th).

🌤️ Weather
I couldn't find a reliable live forecast this morning, so check a weather app before you head out. Older outlooks pointed to a gray, wet day in NYC: a high near 50°F, a low near 42°F, and a good chance of rain (around half an inch).
What to wear/bring: a warm layer and a waterproof jacket, and keep an umbrella handy just in case.

🗞️ Headlines (from Thursday's reporting)
• Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned amid reports about his personal conduct. Nvidia and other AI stocks fell sharply on the news.
• Democrat Scott Colom won Mississippi's Senate race and becomes the state's first Black senator since Reconstruction. That brings the incoming Democratic caucus to 55.
• Alaska's Senate race is still too close to call. Democrat Mary Peltola has widened her narrow lead over Sen. Dan Sullivan, with about 15% of ballots left to count.
• U.S. envoys Witkoff and Kushner are in Russia to meet Putin after the Abu Dhabi talks. European representatives are set to join future Ukraine peace negotiations.
• Haitian and Salvadoran troops took back Port-au-Prince's national stadium after two years of gang control.

🚇 Getting around
• A train: No service between Rockaway Blvd and Ozone Park–Lefferts Blvd until 5 a.m. Monday, Nov 16, because of signal work. Lefferts-bound trains are rerouted to Far Rockaway.
• 1 train: Downtown trains skip 125th St (in effect through Dec 18).
• Heading out this weekend? The J/M have had weekend suspensions this fall, so check the MTA app first.

🎉 NYC today
• The Union Square Holiday Market opened yesterday and runs through Dec 24. It's a good lunch-break wander.
• The New York Comedy Festival is in its final weekend, with shows across the city through Sunday.

💡 Nugget
The fear of Friday the 13th has a name: paraskevidekatriaphobia. Studies have found no real increase in accidents on the day, so the odds are you'll have a perfectly good Friday. 🍀
